用户尚未授权此能力: The user has not authorized this capability
它控制「向终端写入数据」（等价于代替用户敲命令）: It controls terminal input, equivalent to typing commands on the user’s behalf
它控制「修改界面」（CSS / 令牌 / store / 合成事件）: It controls interface changes (CSS / tokens / stores / synthetic events)
它控制「写入配置」（服务器 / 隧道 / 设置）: It controls configuration writes (servers / tunnels / settings)
它需要同时开启「允许读取敏感数据」: It also requires Allow reading sensitive data
它控制「写入凭据」（新增 / 修改 / 删除保存的凭据）: It controls creating, modifying, and deleting saved credentials
它控制「远端文件写入」（SFTP 写 / 删 / 改名 / 建目录 / 上传）: It controls remote file writes (SFTP write / delete / rename / create directory / upload)
已开启远端文件写入，但路径白名单为空（留空 = 禁止任何写入路径），请先填写允许: Remote file writes are enabled, but the path allowlist is empty; add an allowed prefix first (an empty list blocks all writes)
它控制「应用生命周期」（重载 / 退出 / 重启）与清空日志: It controls application lifecycle actions (reload / quit / restart) and clearing logs
它沿用既有开关「允许执行 JS」: It uses the existing Allow JavaScript execution setting
终端读取：读取已授权会话的缓冲区和输出，内容可能包含敏感业务数据。: Terminal output: read the buffer and output of authorized sessions, which may contain sensitive business data.
远端文件读取：读取授权会话的文件和目录；客户端可进一步限定路径。: Remote file reading: read files and directories in authorized sessions; clients may further restrict paths.
界面观测：读取 DOM、控制台、截图，可能包含敏感信息。: Interface inspection: read the DOM, console, and screenshots, which may contain sensitive information.
建立连接：连接已保存服务器或打开会话；使用保存凭据还需要 credentials: Connections: connect to saved servers or open sessions; using saved credentials also requires credentials.use.
断开连接：关闭或重连会话，可能中断正在运行的作业。: Disconnection: close or reconnect sessions, which may interrupt running jobs.
取消传输：停止属于当前调用方的传输，并报告可能残留的文件。: Transfer cancellation: stop transfers owned by the caller and report files that may remain.
本机命令执行：以应用的操作系统身份执行任意命令，须完全信任调用方。: Local command execution: run arbitrary commands as the application’s operating system user; the caller must be fully trusted.
使用凭据：仅允许应用内部使用保存的凭据，不向调用方导出明文。: Credential use: allow the application to use saved credentials internally without exporting plaintext to the caller.
完全信任的界面自动化：允许 DOM 交互或任意 JS，能够触发持久化业务变更及宿: Fully trusted interface automation: allow DOM interaction or arbitrary JavaScript that can trigger persistent business changes and host bindings; this is not a sandbox.
基本读取：应用元信息与安全投影。终端、文件、界面和敏感字段分别要求对应读取权限。: Basic reading: application metadata and safe projections. Terminal output, files, interface data, and sensitive fields each require their corresponding read permissions.
终端输入：向会话写入数据，等价于在该终端里键入命令。风险：可执行任意远端命令；可: Terminal input: write data to a session, equivalent to typing commands. Risk: can execute arbitrary remote commands and cause irreversible effects. Executes within the user-authorized scope without a token for each call.
界面写入：修改 CSS / 设计令牌 / 前端 store / 合成 DOM 事: Interface writes: change CSS, design tokens, frontend stores, or synthetic DOM events to verify interface changes. Risk: can trigger persistent changes. Disabled by default; arbitrary DOM interaction also requires automation.trusted.
配置写入：修改服务器、隧道与应用设置（权限与监听设置只能由用户管理）。风险：可持: Configuration writes: change servers, tunnels, and application settings (only the user manages permissions and listening settings). Risk: can persist incorrect configuration. Disabled by default; setting changes are irreversible and require two-step confirmation.
凭据写入：新增 / 修改 / 删除保存的凭据，不要求导出敏感数据；需用户批准。: Credential writes: create, modify, or delete saved credentials without requiring sensitive data export; user approval is required.
sudo 凭证提权：允许 AI 在当前会话对应的服务器上，用应用里保存的密码执行: sudo credential elevation: allow AI to run sudo -i on this session’s server using the saved password, granting AI root access. Prerequisite: credentials.use must also be enabled; internal password use does not require secrets.read plaintext export permission. The password is excluded from MCP arguments, results, logs, audit records, and tool schemas, and callers cannot supply it directly. It is written only to a random remote temporary file (/tmp/.ding-sudo-<12 random hexadecimal characters>, mode 600), then deleted and verified. The temporary path must also match the remote write allowlist; otherwise the operation is rejected. Local terminals and servers without saved passwords are unsupported. Extremely high risk, disabled by default, and enabling requires a second confirmation; every terminal.sudo call still requires two-step confirmation.
执行 JS：在页面上下文执行任意脚本（等价于完全控制界面）。要求「允许执行 JS: JavaScript execution: run arbitrary scripts in the page context, equivalent to full interface control. Requires Allow JavaScript execution and automation.trusted; may invoke host bindings and cause persistent effects.
